title: Claim-Record Relief on the Multi-Policy Discount Stop (RentGuard Renters Policy)
content:
Training note on stop relief for the claim record under the RentGuard Renters Policy. The claim file of the renters policy decides how many relief points apply to the charge owed when the policy's multi-policy discount stops.

**Rule.** When no renters claim was reported on the policy in the last 60 calendar months, 10 relief points apply to the discount-stop charge; when at least one renters claim was reported in the last 60 calendar months but no renters claim payment was issued in the last 36 calendar months, 5 relief points apply; when a renters claim payment was issued in the last 36 calendar months, no claim-record relief points apply.

**Which records are read?**
The claim entries of the renters policy: claims reported (first notice of loss, by date reported) over the last 60 calendar months, and claim payments issued (by date issued) over the last 36 calendar months.

**What if no claim at all was reported in the last 60 calendar months?**
10 relief points apply.

**What if a claim was reported within 60 calendar months, but every payment on it, if any, was issued more than 36 calendar months ago?**
No renters claim payment falls in the last 36 calendar months, so 5 relief points apply.

**What if a claim was reported within 60 calendar months and a renters claim payment was issued in the last 36 calendar months?**
No claim-record relief points apply.

| Claims reported, last 60 calendar months | Claim payments issued, last 36 calendar months | Relief points |
|---|---|---|
| None | — | 10 |
| One or more | None | 5 |
| One or more | One or more | 0 |
